newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Atlas Copco sees $700 mln goodwill from U.S. buy.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Copco sees $700 mln goodwill from U.S. buy.

text.p: Swedish industrial engineer Atlas Copco said on Monday that its proposed acquisition of U.S. machinery leasing group Prime Service Inc would generate $700 million in goodwill.

"Apart from the goodwill that we will see through our acquisition, Prime Service has in its balance calculated some goodwill from earlier acquisitions," Atlas Copco's economic director Lennart Johansson told a news conference.
"In total the goodwill will amount to about $700 million."
Atlas Copco announced earlier on Monday that it had made a bid worth seven billion crowns, or $900 million, for Prime Service, offering $32 a share.
The bid has been approved by Prime Service's board and 74 percent of its shareholders.
At 0925 GMT Atlas Copco shares were five crowns higher at 214.5.
